messages:
Priya K: heads-up — MidMarket client ‘ClearWave’ just flagged onboarding friction in the 2nd week, possible renewal red light in 30 days. noticed big drop in active flows in dashboards.
Alex M: ugh. which flows? onboarding checklist or API integrations?
Priya K: integrations mostly. they hit errors on the webhook mapping step and abandoned the email mapping. logs show 422 from our webhook receiver.
Dylan S: I can triage. can someone drop the customer id and latest error snippet?
Priya K: customer id: cw-8812. error in logs: `POST /webhooks/receive 422 {"error":"invalid_field:contact_email"}`
Samira R: ok I'll own the save plan coordination. propose short-term: 1) Enable a temporary webhook-pass-through to bypass validation, 2) schedule a 30-min enablement call with their integration lead, 3) offer a one-month usage credit if we get them to production within 2 weeks.
Alex M: agree. engineering can enable a pass-through flag for cw-8812. Dylan — can you add a safe toggle? keep audit log.
Dylan S: yes — will add `integration_bypass=true` on the customer config for 72h, with auto-revert. pushing change now. patch: `curl -X POST /internal/customers/cw-8812/flags -d '{"integration_bypass":true}'`
CS Ops Bot: [action created] #ticket-4521 assigned to Samira R — "ClearWave onboarding save: integration bypass + enablement call". Due: 2026-04-03
Priya K: Samira can you schedule the call? target attendees: their PM + integration lead, our solutions engineer (Alex) and me.
Samira R: scheduled for Tue 10am PT, invite sent. agenda: repro, temporary bypass, timeline to full fix, and migration checklist. adding a short enablement doc snippet in the invite.
Samira R: also collecting feedback: asking them to fill 3 quick questions after call so we can capture friction origin and tooling gaps. will post results in #cs-feedback.
Alex M: on the technical next steps: after bypass, we should add a strict validation mode to our integration test harness so this doesn't recur. filing tech debt ticket.
Dylan S: patch deployed, flag active. reverted test in staging. monitor logs for 10m and I'll report back.
Priya K: saved the renewal bit: I'll mark this as "at-risk — early intervention" and loop AM to offer tailored onboarding hours if needed. thanks team.
Alex M: thumbs up. Samira — can you add the proposed downgrade path in the ticket in case they still need to reduce usage? quick bullets: prorated downgrade, maintain read-only exports, 60-day re-up offer.
Samira R: added downgrade options to ticket-4521. also added a short customer-facing script for CSMs to use if they request a downgrade.
Priya K: perfect. after call pls paste the 3-item feedback here and I'll convert to a short eval for product to track recurring patterns.
Samira R: will do. :white_check_mark:
CS Ops Bot: [ticket-4521] status updated -> in-progress (Samira R)."
